text: いいもの　あげようと　したのに　にもつが　いっぱいじゃ！

structure.jp: いいもの　あげようと　したのに
structure.en: I was going to give you something nice, but

structure.jp: にもつが　いっぱいじゃ！

patterns.name: 〜ようとする
patterns.explanation: A verb in its 'let's' shape followed by とする means trying to do it or being about to do it. あげようとした = 'I was about to give'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに joins two parts with 'even though', and sounds let down. あげようとしたのに = 'even though I was going to give it'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the way old men in stories say だ, 'is'. いっぱいじゃ = 'it is full'.
